current.scored_text:
A one-time trigger uses the `/whisk.system/alarms/once` feed and fires on a specified date. For example:
`ibmcloud fn trigger create fireOnce --feed /whisk.system/alarms/once --param date "2019-12-25T12:30:00.000Z" --param trigger_payload "{\"name\":\"Odin\",\"place\":\"Asgard\"}" --param deleteAfterFire "rules"` [S3][S4]

A periodic trigger uses the `/whisk.system/alarms/interval` feed and fires repeatedly according to an interval-based schedule. [S4]
